description:
A collection's floor price over time in ETH, one point a day (at
most 31, evenly spaced over a long period), with the floor at the
start and now and the change between them in percent. Answers "how
has the floor of X moved?". It takes a slug: when you have a name,
call search_gondi first and take the slug from its result.

collection_slug.description: The GONDI slug of the collection.
collection_slug.title: Collection Slug

name: get_floor_price_history

day.description: The UTC day the floor was last seen on.
day.title: Day

outputSchema.description:
Floors in ETH at each sample's own rate, the lowest across the
collection and its wrappers.

change_percent.description: From the start floor to the end one; null without both.
change_percent.title: Change Percent

points.description: Oldest first, one per day, thinned to at most 31 evenly spaced days that keep the latest.
points.title: Points

start_floor_price.description: The floor when the period began; null when none was seen.
start_floor_price.title: Start Floor Price

outputSchema.title: FloorPriceHistory

title: Floor price history
